rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an attractively slender person.

example.jyutping: keoi5 san1 coi4 hou2 miu4 tiu4

rows.note: Use this for a chance or prospect that is very unlikely.

example.english: The chances of getting rich through the lottery are slim.
example.traditional: 想靠抽獎發達，機會好渺茫。
example.jyutping: soeng2 kaau3 cau1 zoeng2 faat3 daat6 gei1 wui6 hou2 miu5 mong4

rows.note: Use this for clothes or styles that make the wearer look slimmer.

example.english: This dress makes you look slim.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 hin2 sau3

rows.note: Use this for an object or shape that is long and narrow.

example.english: This pen is slim and long, so it is comfortable to hold.
example.traditional: 呢支筆形狀幼長，拎住好舒服。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 bat1 jing4 zong6 jau3 coeng4 ling1 zyu6 hou2 syu1 fuk6
